Commentary.Commentary: That is it! South Africa are seen posing with the trophy. All smiles in their camp and they deserve all the applause they are getting from the crowd. They have been brilliant in the ODI series, except for the last match. Sri Lanka, on the other hand, have shown great improvement as the series progressed. Now the two teams will turn their attention to the shortest format which will be played on the 14th of August at 1900 local (1330 GMT). Till then you can catch the action of the Test match going on between England and India. Goodbye.

South Africa skipper, Quinton de Kock, says it is good to win the series. Admits it is not easy to come here and win. Emphasizes the importance of the series win and credits the way Sri Lanka played today. Reckons the toss did not make a lot of difference. Ends by saying Akila is a very good bowler and it is not easy facing him.

Man of the series, JP Duminy, says that it is a bitter-sweet feeling. Adds that he is disappointed about today but with the series win, he is happy. Says that being 3-0 up in Sri Lanka is not easy and they will take positives from it. On retiring from Test cricket he says that it was not an easy decision but so far so good for him. He says that he has been working on his batting and is happy to reap rewards from it. About the team he says that the batting has been good and their mindset has been positive. Ends by saying that he is looking forward to the T20I game as he is the captain of the side.

Sri Lanka skipper, Angelo Mathews, says this is the performance they were looking for but it came a touch too late. Mentions they take a lot of positives from the game and he feels everybody chipped in today. Further adds the wicket was a bit on the slower side but once he got in, scoring became easier. Credits the way South Africa played. Ends by saying they are trying to improve and looking to get better each and every day.

Sri Lanka skipper, Angelo Mathews, says this is the performance they were looking for but it came a touch too late. Mentions they take a lot of positives from the game and he feels everybody chipped in today. Further adds the wicket was a bit on the slower side but once he got in, scoring became easy. Credits the way South Africa played. Ends by saying they are trying to improve and looking to get better each and every day.

Man of the Match, Akila Dananjaya, says today was his best performance and he is very happy. Adds further he wanted to be the best bowler of the series and he feels he has achieved it. Mentions he is looking forward to excel in all the formats. Ends by saying he has worked hard on his variations and they are coming out well.

That is where the procession started as Reeza bagged a first ball duck and Klaasen too walked back cheaply. Duminy and de Kock tried to steady the ship but the former fell prey to another spinner, Dhananjaya de Silva. The visitors never recovered after that as the last 5 wickets fell for less than 30 runs. De Kock, their skipper, fought a lone battle but never got any support.

After posting a target which I felt was above par, courtesy four 50 plus-run stands and an outstanding 97 from Mathews, the Lankans came out all guns blazing with the ball. Lakmal started things off with an absolute beauty, getting rid of Amla for nought. Markram and de Kock did try and counter-attack but the former's woes against spin continued as he fell prey to Akila.

An excellent batting performance has been followed up with an even better show with the ball. I did mention in my first innings text that with the wicket providing assistance to the spinners, Akila will hold the key and hasn't he delivered in some style! A 6-fer, he has ran through the battling line up of South Africa and helped Sri Lanka win quite comprehensively.

OUT! That's that! South Africa are all out! Kumara lands one short and wide outside off, Dala looks to cut it but finds Dhananjaya at point. He cannot take it on the first attempt but manages to hold on to it. Sri Lanka win by 178 runs.
FOUR!  Kumara digs this one short own the leg side. Dala pulls it away fine and it goes on the bounce to the fine leg fence.
Back of a length ball on the leg side, Rabada tucks it away for another run.
Short and wide outside off, Dala guides it to third man to get off strike.
Another leggie by the bowler, Rabada defends it.

OUT! In the air... taken! 6-fer for Akila. The game keeps getting better for him. These are also the best figures at Colombo for a spinner. He tosses this one up, it is the leg spinner. Maharaj dances down the track does not get to the pitch of it. Still goes ahead with the shot and all he manages to do is hit it up in the air towards mid off where Lakmal takes it.
Junior Dala is the last man in.
Flatter on middle, kept out.
Hits this through long off for a run.
Just over! An excellent work in the deep from Kusal Perera. Rabada steps down the track and goes inside out over covers. KP in the deep runs after the ball, dives and saves a couple for his side.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Length ball on off, Maharaj blocks it with a straight bat.
Back of a length ball down the leg side, flicked away through square leg for a run.
FOUR! Another one! This time from the bat off Rabada. Kumara bowls one short outside off, Rabada cuts it over the slip region. It's too fine for the third man fielder to stop it.
Back of a length ball around off, Rabada taps it to the off side.
Pushed to the cover region by KM. One run added to the total.
FOUR! Short and outside the off pole, Maharaj lashes hard at it and gets a top edge which flies over the slip cordon for a boundary.
Serves in a juicy full toss on middle, Keshav hits it along the turf for one.
Loopy ball on the pads, flicked away to square leg.
Tosses this one up on leg, played to mid-wicket for a run.
Off spinner outside off, Rabada leaves it alone.
Mix up but safe. Maharaj drives this towards extra cover. They hesitate but finally make it.
Inside edge! Comes forward to block this but the ball takes an inside edge which saves him.
Another ball on the shorter side, Rabada punches it to mid on.
On a good length around off, the batsman blocks it out.
Good length on off, the batsman defends.
Another bouncer on middle, the batsman ducks under it.
A bumper on middle, the batsman ducks under it. It has been wided.
Back of a length on off, the batsman tries to defend but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Back of a length on off, the batsman defends it.
Down the leg side, Rabada flicks it through mid-wicket. No fielder there and a brace results.
On off, Rabada prods forward and blocks it.
Loopy ball on middle, Rabada defends it.
Kagiso Rabada walks out to bat.

OUT! EDGED AND TAKEN! Guess who is the wicket taker? Akila Dananjaya. He gets a fifer. What a performance by the young lad. He seems to be getting better after each game. Another beauty. Flighted ball on off, this one pitches and then turns away. Andile just like his captain plays inside the line. The ball kisses the outside edge and settles into the mitts of the keeper. He catches it and appeals and the umpire raises his finger. 2 wickets away now are Lanka.
Slower through the air on middle, it turns away. Andile lunges and bloks it out.
Flighted ball on middle, the batsman lunges and blocks it.
Length ball outside off, Maharaj is happy to shoulder his arms to it.
Kumara continues bowling short. Maharaj sways away from it.
Darts this full around off, Andile gets a soft leading edge through point for a run.
Some chin music for Andile, he lets that bouncer through to the wicket-keeper.
Back of a length ball around off, defended off the back foot.
Andile picked that bouncer early and let it through to the keeper.
Keshav Maharaj is the new man in.

OUT! BOWLED'EM! Akila gets his fourth. He has done excatly what he was brought into the attack to do. Another brilliant delivery. The googly on off, it pitches and then turns away. De Kock does not account for the spin as he plays inside the line. The ball beats the outside edge and hits the off pole. Dananjaya is ecstatic as de Kock walks back after a good innings.
Works it with the angle for a run.
Flighted ball on middle, the batsman tucks it to mid-wicket.
On off, kept out.
Floats it up on off, Andile goes for the sweep but misses to get hit on the pads. The players appeal but the umpire shakes his head.
Slower through the air on middle, the batsman keeps it out.
Akila Dananjaya is back on.
Nicely played! Shorter delivery on the body of the batsman. Andile tucks it to fine leg for a run,
Back of a length on off, Andile defends it to covers.
Andile Phehlukwayo is the new man in.

OUT! Three reds and another one bites the dust. Also, South Africa lose their sole review. Excellent by Kumara, follows the short one with a length ball around middle, this one pitches and comes back in. Mulder tries to defend but misses to get hit on the pads. The players appeal and the umpire raises his finger. Mulder after a chat with his captain goes for the review. Time for the replays, it shows no bat and three reds.
Mulder is a goner! He has been give out LBW but he has gone for the review. Looks out.
A good pacey bowler on off, Mulder ducks under it.
This time stands still and tucks it around the corner for a run.
Almost chopped it on! A bumper on middle, de Kock goes for the pull but gets a bottom edge which goes agonizingly close past the leg pole. The ball goes down to fine leg and a brace results.
Driven through the covers by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Dances down track and whips it through mid-wicket for a run.
50 up for de Kock. His 17th in ODIs and his first as skipper. He is fighting a lone battle out there. He eases this through covers and gets to that milestone.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. The batsmen have run through for a single.

NOT OUT! His foot is well grounded. De Silva angles this outside off, Mulder goes for the drive but misses. Dickwella collects the ball and whips the bails off. He appeals and the umpire takes it upstairs. Replays show, Mulder never lifted his foot.
Has Mulder lifted his foot? Dickwella puts in a confident appeal after whipping the bails off. They have taken it upstairs.
Willem Mulder is the new man in.

OUT! Caught and bowled! De Silva provides the breakthrough, breaks the 46-run stand. It is the huge wicket of Duminy, the man in form. He walks back cheaply and one would believe the chase is now a huge task. Duminy uses his feet and tries to work it across the line. Never a good idea. He gets a leading edge back to the bowler as it straightens a touch. Dhananjaya takes the simple of catches. Half the side back in the hut and they still need another 215.
FOUR! Ends the over in style! 11 from Kumara's first. De Kock steps down the track and lofts it over the bowler's head and another boundary results.
Helps it with the angle through backward square leg for a run.
On a length and around off, the batsman strokes it through covers and a single results.
Fuller in length on off, de Kock drives it to mid off.
FOUR! A slower ball on the shorter side, too easy for de Kock. He has all the time in the world to go back and pull it. Place it wherever he wants, he does so perfectly through the square leg region.
Uses his feet and hits this down to long off for a run.
Lahiru Kumara is into the attack.
FOUR! Cheeky from QDK. A slower ball outside off, de Kock gets in position and reverse sweeps this just past the keeper for a boundary.
It's been driven superbly through the covers but straight to the man there.
Slower ball on middle, de Kock gets low and sweeps this through square leg for a brace.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Quicker one on middle and leg. De kock looks to hit it on the leg side but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Flatter one on middle and leg, hit to mid on for nothing.
Back of a length ball, Duminy goes for the pull but it goes off the inner half towards square leg for a run.
The batsman plays a pull shot to this short delivery. One run added to the total.
On the shorter side, de Kock tries to pull but mistimes it to mid-wicket.
The batsman plays the pull shot.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. The batsmen have run through for a single.
The batsman opens the face of the bat and helps it to third man. They pick up a single.
Gives this air outside off, de Kock drives it towards extra cover for a single.
FOUR! Shot! Superb from the skipper. Leans ahead and drives this with some force past that cover fielder. The ball races away to the fence.
Good this from Akila. Four dots in a row. Another off spinner on off, hit to covers.
Quicker and full on the pads, QDK squeezes this towards mid off.
Tosses this one up around off, de Kock drives it to covers.
Loopy ball around off, de Kock goes for the swipe but does not make any contact.
Short of a length on middle, de Kock pulls it through square leg for a run.
SIX! BANG! Top shot! He uses his feet and lofts this over the long on fence for a maximum.
The batsman has played it to the point region.
Back of a length on off, Duminy guides it down to third man for a run.
The batsman gets a bottom edge of the bat on that one. They pick up a single.
Steps down the track and drives this through covers for a run.
And Thisara Perera will bowl his first over.
Powerplay 2 has been signalled. 4 fielders can now stand outside the inner circle till the 40th over.
Duminy is nimble on his feet as he strokes this to mid on for a run.
The batsman has been hit on the pads as he tried to sweep that one. The batsmen have run through for a single. The umpire signals leg bye.
Dances down the track again but once again it is bowled short. De Kock cuts it towards point. The fielder there misfields and concedes two.
Short ball stays a touch low, de Kock goes for the pull but misses to get hit on the pads.
Uses his feet and Akila shortens his length. De Kock defends it.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Starighter ball on middle, Duminy tries to defend but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
FOUR! Slightly short and Duminy takes full toll of it. He punches it and also finds the gap through covers.
Flatter outside off, de Kock cuts it to the man at point. The fielder there dives to stop it. He can't stop a single though.
Flatter on off, de Kock punches it to covers.
Floats it up on middle, de Kock works it to mid-wicket.
Dhananjaya de Silva is into the attack.
Floats it up on off, Duminy defends it. Another successful over by Dananjaya comes to an end.
JP Duminy is the new man in.

OUT! That is as plumb as you can get! Akila Dananjaya is on a roll here. He gets his third and South Africa are in dire straits. The googly on off, Klaasen has no clue on which way the ball is turning. He tries to flick but misses. The ball hits him on the pads. An appeal follows and the umpire is quick to raise his finger. Klaasen has a chat with de Kock but his skipper says, do not even think about taking the review.
Eases this through mid off for a run.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
FOUR! Poor ball and it has been put away! Short and outside off, de Kock waits for it and then guides it past backward point.
In the air... but safe! Klaasen plays the sweep shot but gets a top edge. It lands safe towards deep square leg for a run.

NOT OUT! It was off the thigh pad and Sri Lanka's sole review goes down the drain. This was down the leg side, de Kock tries to flick and there seems to be some noise as the ball passes the bat. It goes into the mitts of the keeper who takes it and appeals. The umpire shakes his head and the keeper convinces his captain to go for the review. Mathews does so. Replays roll in and it shows it is off the thigh pad.
Howzzat? Not out is the answer to that question. Dickwella though feels de Kock has edged it and they have taken it upstairs. Big moment in the game.

Overthrow! Just not needed, this was just not needed. Another exceptional delivery by Lakmal. On a length and around off, Klaasen defends it towards point. The fielder has a unnecessary shy at the bowler's end and he hits. The ball deflects past the fielder backing up and an overthrow results.
Hits the length hard and bowls it on off, all the batsman can do is defend it.
Length again on off, the batsman lunges and blocks it.
Good length again on off, Klaasen is rooted to his crease as he keeps it out.
On a length around middle, kept out.
Not the best of deliveries, especially on the hat-trick ball. The full toss on off, Klaasen drives it towards long off for a run. End of a double-wicket over.
Heinrich Klaasen walks out to face the hat-trick ball.

OUT! Timber! It was the leg spinner which got the better of Markram on the previous ball and it is the googly which gets the better of Reeza. Sensational stuff from Akila. He tosses this up on off, Hendricks tries to defend it leaving a gap between bat and pad. The ball sneaks through and hits the off pole. The Lankans are ecstatic as RH bags a golden duck. Akila is on a hat-trick.
Reeza Hendricks is the new man in.

OUT! Aiden Markram's woes against spin continues. His return in the team was a breezy one but a short one. Akila bowls a flighted ball on off, it was the leg spinner. Markram tries to drive it down the ground but fails to keep it down. It goes to the left of Akila who takes a good diving catch. He throws it up in the air in joy and Markram walks back dejected. South Africa in trouble now.
The leg spinner on off, Markram drives it to mid off.
Tucks it with the angle towards short fine leg for a run.
The short of length delivery has been cut away through square on the off side.

FOUR! WOW! This is the best out of the boundaries hit so far! Not a lot wrong with the delivery. On a length around middle, Markram punches it right off the middle, beating the diving mid on and the ball races away to the fence for consecutive boundaries.
FOUR! Anything short and Markram will put it away. Short and outside off, Aiden stands tall and guides it past point and the ball races away.
Works this one wide of mid-wicket and takes a run.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman.
Good length on middle, this one shapes back in. De Kock tries to flick but misses.

NOT OUT! De Kock is well in. A back of a length delivery on off, the batsman chops it towards slip. He takes a start but then seeing it went straight to hand, he turns and tries to get back in. The fielder at slip, Mathews, hits bull's eye at the striker's end and appeals. The umpire takes it upstairs. Replays show, de Kock is well in.
A direct hit at the striker's end and it has been referred upstairs. De Kock though seems to be safe but just to be sure.
The googly by Dananjaya, Markram does not pick it. He tries to drive but it goes off the inner half towards mid on.
Floated up ball on off, de Kock lunges and strokes it towards wide mid off for a single.
Flighted ball on off, de Kock drives it to mid off.
Flatter on middle, de Kock defends it.
FOUR! 5 boundaries in the 20 they have scored! De Kock is nimble on his feet as he gets to the pitch of it. Takes the spin out of contention and flicks it over wide long on for a boundary.
A drag down on off, de Kock cuts it but finds covers. That should have been hit to the fence. It was a nothing delivery.
So 5 dots after going for a boundary on the very first ball. This one is angled into the batsman. He keeps it out.
Shortens his length seeing there is no swing on offer. Markram defends it to point.
Goes fuller again in search of some swing. There ain't any and the batsman drives it to covers.
Fuller in length on off, Markram strokes it to mid off.
On the pads, Markram tries to flick but the ball brushes his pads. The keeper does really well to dive and stop it. Saves a boundary.

FOUR! South Africa are dealing in boundaries. Another back of a length delivery on off, Markram off the back foot punches it through covers and another boundary results. All the runs have come in the form of boundaries till now.
FOUR! Nope, the last ball spoils the over. Short and on off, de Kock goes back and punches it through covers and the ball races to the fence.
5 now! Another loopy ball on middle, de Kock strokes it to covers. Can he bowl a maiden?
Flatter on off, de Kock pushes it to covers. 4 dots.
Uses his feet but does not get to the pitch of the delivery. De Kock defends it.
A huge appeal but not given! The straighter one which beats the defense of de Kock. It hits him on the front pad. The players appeal but the umpire shakes his head. Missing leg.
Tosses this up on middle, de Kock drives it to covers.
Akila Dananjaya to bowl from the other end.
FOUR! Too easy for Markram. Lakmal serves one down the leg side, Markram just helps it on its way and the ball runs to the fine leg fence.
FOUR! What a way to get off the mark. Short and wide outside off, Markram reaches for it and cuts it over point for a boundary.
Aiden Markram is the new man in.

OUT! You beauty! What a ball from Lakmal! The perfect start for Sri Lanka. Lands this on a good length around off. The ball moves away a touch after pitching. Amla looks to play it with a straight bat but his feet are all over the place. The ball goes past him and hits the top of off pole.
Length ball around that off pole, Amla blocks it out.
Back of a length ball on middle and leg, Hashim flicks it off his pads to mid-wicket.
Starts of by bowling one on a good length around off. Amla gets forward and blocks it out.

We are back for the chase. Skipper Mathews has some final words before they head out to take the field. Quinton de Kock and Hashim Amla will open for South Africa. Suranga Lakmal will bowl the first over. A slip in place. Here we go...
